name: Grandmother
ability: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
wakes: First night only, to be shown the Grandchild. She does not wake on other nights; the other-nights slot is where the Storyteller resolves her death if the Demon killed the Grandchild.
interaction: Learns: One good player (the Grandchild) and that player's character.
drunk_or_poisoned: Drunk or poisoned on the first night: may be shown a wrong player and/or character (misinformation offered centrally). Drunk or poisoned when the Demon kills the Grandchild: she does not die.

jinxes.text: If the Leviathan is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.

rulings.text: If the Demon kills the Grandchild, the Grandmother dies too (mark her DEAD).
If the Grandchild dies any other way (execution, Gambler, a non-Demon night death) the Grandmother survives.
A drunk Grandmother (e.g. made drunk by the Sailor) survives the Demon killing her Grandchild.
The Storyteller chooses a good player as Grandchild while preparing the first night and marks them GRANDCHILD.

test_scenarios.name: shown grandchild on first night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Grandmother, Bob Professor, Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef. Storyteller marks Bob as Grandchild.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob is the Professor.

test_scenarios.name: demon kills grandchild, grandmother dies
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Grandmother, Bob Professor (Grandchild), Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: At dawn both Bob and Alice are announced dead.

test_scenarios.name: grandchild executed, grandmother survives
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Grandmother, Bob Professor (Grandchild), Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Bob is executed. Night 2: Imp kills Eve.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice stays alive; only Bob (day) and Eve (night) die.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned grandmother: misinformation and survival
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Grandmother, Bob Tinker (Grandchild), Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef. Poisoner poisons Alice on night 1 and night 2.
test_scenarios.actions: First night: Grandmother wakes; misinformation options are offered centrally and the storyteller picks Bob as the Chef (Bob is really the Tinker). Night 2: Imp kills Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob is the Chef (Bob is really the Tinker); at dawn Bob is dead and Alice survives.
